summary.title: At a glance
items: We only store your email, account ID, and the photos and notes you upload
Only you can open your data — we never share it or use it for training
Photos are stripped of EXIF location data and normalized to 1:1 square before upload
You can delete your data any time

sections.title: 1. Information we collect
sections.body:
Skin Diary collects the following information.

- Account: email address, authentication identifier (uid), and sign-in method (Google or email/password)
- User content: face photos you upload (front, left, right) and lifestyle notes (water, food, products, exercise, memo)
- Automatic: login session and in-progress draft data in localStorage. We do not collect ad identifiers or location.

sections.title: 2. How we use it
sections.body:
We use the information solely to preserve and compare your own skin diary. We do not use it for any of the following.

- Training AI or machine-learning models
- Advertising or behavioral analytics
- Selling or sharing data with third parties

sections.title: 3. Storage and retention
sections.body: Data is stored on Google Firebase (Firebase Authentication, Cloud Firestore, and Cloud Storage). When you delete your account or an individual record, the data is permanently removed. Any residual copies on backup media are rotated out within 30 days.

sections.title: 4. Third parties and processors
sections.body: We do not sell or share your data with third parties. We use Google LLC (Firebase) as our infrastructure processor. Google OAuth is used only to authenticate sign-in; we do not transmit user content to Google.

sections.title: 5. Your rights
sections.body:
You can exercise the following rights at any time.

- Access: view your records and photos directly in the app
- Correction: edit each day's record directly
- Deletion: remove individual records or delete your account to erase all data permanently

sections.title: 6. Cookies and local storage
sections.body: We use the browser's localStorage and cookies to keep you signed in and to preserve in-progress drafts. We do not use external trackers for advertising or behavioral analytics. You can clear this storage from your browser settings.

sections.title: 7. Children
sections.body: Users under 14 cannot register without verifiable parental consent. If we learn that a minor's information was collected without consent, we will delete it immediately.

sections.title: 8. Changes to this policy
sections.body: If we make material changes to this policy, we will notify you in-app or by email at least 7 days before they take effect. Continuing to use the service after changes means you accept the updated policy.

sections.title: 9. Contact
sections.body: For privacy questions, contact svs02po@gmail.com. Skin Diary is a beta service run by a single maker, so replies may take a few days.

summary.title: At a glance
items: Skin Diary is a personal record-keeping tool — it is not medical diagnosis or advice
You own 100% of the photos and notes you upload
It's a beta service run by a single maker; pauses or changes can happen
Uploading other people's photos without consent or any inappropriate content is not allowed

sections.title: 1. The service
sections.body: Skin Diary (the "Service") is a personal record-keeping tool that helps you store and compare your face photos and lifestyle notes over time. It does not provide medical diagnosis, treatment, or prescription, and it is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

sections.title: 2. Acceptance and changes
sections.body: These terms take effect when you complete sign-up. We will give you in-app notice at least 7 days before changes take effect (30 days for changes that disadvantage you). If you do not agree to the changes, you can stop using the service by deleting your account.

sections.title: 3. Your account
sections.body: You are responsible for keeping your account credentials (password, OAuth session) secure. You are responsible for activity under your account. If you suspect unauthorized access, change your password immediately and let the maker know.

sections.title: 4. Content ownership
sections.body: You retain full copyright and ownership of the photos and notes you upload. The maker processes your content only as needed to provide the service (storage, display, image normalization) and does not use it for any other purpose.

sections.title: 5. Prohibited use
sections.body:
The following are not allowed.

- Uploading another person's photo or information without their consent
- Uploading inappropriate content such as sexual or violent imagery
- Abnormal access to the service (bots, exploiting vulnerabilities)
- Selling or supplying the service's output to third parties as medical evidence

sections.title: 6. Availability and termination
sections.body: Skin Diary is a beta service operated by a single maker. The service may pause or end without prior notice due to maintenance, technical issues, or operational reasons. If we sunset the service, we will give at least 30 days' notice so you can review or delete your records during that window.

sections.title: 7. Disclaimer
sections.body: Skin Diary is solely a tool for storing and comparing your own records. Nothing visible in your photos or notes constitutes medical evidence. Decisions about your skin (visiting a clinic, choosing treatments or products) are your own responsibility, and the maker is not liable for outcomes.

sections.title: 8. Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Korea. We will try to resolve disputes in good faith first; if that fails, the court of the user's domicile will be the first-instance court.

sections.title: 9. Contact
sections.body: For questions about these terms, contact svs02po@gmail.com.
